tool.description: Origin tool from the `Wf-Tool` trailer, absent when unset.

changes.description: The submitted changes (chunked per file, chronological).

PromoteReportDoc.description: Impact report returned when a draft is promoted to formal.

QueryBody.description:
Wire shape of the query endpoints: filters (basic + advanced
expressions) plus sort / pagination overrides.

ReachabilityDoc.description: Reachability analysis result (sets rendered as sorted arrays).

RebuildIndexResponse.description: Rebuild response: number of indexed commits.

RejectedRowDoc.description:
One row a scan reached but could not read, reported beside the rows that
could be read so a single broken record cannot hide the rest of a tree.

resolutions.description:
Resolved file contents keyed by workspace-relative path (base64
callers decode before sending; transport carries raw JSON strings).

checkpoint.description: File checkpoint (commit) id to restore from.

entity.description: Execution or entity id owning the checkpoint.

RestorePreviewDoc.description:
Preview of what a restore would bring back (`wf_api::RestorePreview`
mirrored).

RestoredCheckpointDoc.description:
Restored execution state (`wf_api::RestoredCheckpoint` mirrored); the
live entity handle is `#[serde(skip)]` and never serializes.

RunAgentLoopBody.description:
Wire body of `/agent-loops/{id}/run` and `/stream`: the flattened
`AgentLoopConfig` fields plus the loop input.

checkpoint_message_interval.description:
Checkpoint every N appended conversation messages (`None` disables
the message-count backstop). Wired through to
`AgentLoopConfig::checkpoint_message_interval`.

file_scope.description:
Optional per-execution filesystem scope. Missing inherits the parent
execution then the global default; explicit values override per field.

ScriptExecuteBody.description:
Wire shape of `/scripts/execute` and `/scripts/validate`: mirrors
`wf_api::ScriptExecuteParams` with deserializable field types.

StateFileLinkDoc.description:
Health of the state-to-file association for one state checkpoint
(`wf_checkpoint::file::StateFileLinkStatus` flattened).

checkpoint_id.description: State checkpoint id that was queried.

file_commit_id.description: Linked file commit id; present for `linked` and `pending`.

state.description:
`linked` when the durable link exists, `pending` when the link write
failed and awaits startup compensation, `missing` when no link was
ever recorded.

StateTransitionDoc.description: One status transition of a workflow execution.

StoreStatsDoc.description:
Read-only object-store statistics for the storage dashboard
(`wf_checkpoint::gc::StoreStats` mirrored).

last_gc_ms.description:
Time of the last completed GC run (Unix milliseconds), absent when
no GC has run yet.

loose_objects.description: Loose objects currently in the object store.

store_bytes.description: Total bytes occupied by the bare repository directory.

actor.description: Actor the edit line is attributed to (required, no anonymous writes).

session.description: Optional session attribution recorded alongside the actor.

SubtreeDoc.description: One page of the executions below a root, breadth-first.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the following page; absent on the last page.

nodes.description: Root first, then each level in child order.

omitted.description: How many descendants sit past this page.

truncated.description: Set when nodes remain past this page; follow `next_cursor` for them.

SubtreeNodeDoc.description: One node of a subtree listing.

depth.description: Nesting level relative to the queried root, which is `0`.

status.description: Absent only for a live execution whose record has not been written yet.

TemplateSummaryDoc.description: Uniform template summary over workflow and agent templates.

TimelineEventDoc.description:
One lifecycle event on the history timeline.

Every field mirrors `wf_types::events::BaseEvent` except the
discriminator: that enum's variants grow with the engines, so a schema
mirroring it would have to be rebuilt on every addition. The wire declares
the string the enum actually serializes to instead, taking its
`SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE` names such as `WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_STARTED`.

ToolCallDoc.description: One tool call inside an agent iteration.

UnifiedExecutionDoc.description: One run in the unified listing, regardless of owning engine.

UnitDoc.description:
Empty payload (`data: null`, e.g. the metadata PUT): utoipa cannot
render `()` in a generic envelope, so the unit response is named.

ValidationIssueDoc.description: One validation issue on a draft: dotted field path plus message.

WorkspaceFileDoc.description:
Reconstructed file of an actor partition
(`wf_checkpoint::provenance::WorkspaceFile` mirrored): `content` is the
raw bytes as a JSON number array (metadata consumers read path, hash and
timestamp only).
